name: Move Kingz LLC
address: 12965 W Dixie Hwy, North Miami, FL 33161, United States
website_check: Domain verification performed before any build work. DNS lookup (python3 socket.gethostbyname) for movekingz.com, movekingzllc.com, movekingz.net, movekingzllc.net, movekingzmoving.com and movekingzmovers.com returned 'Name or service not known' for all six: none of these domains resolve, confirmed independently of the agent proxy (which also rejected the CONNECT attempts as host-not-found). The only movekings-style domain that resolves live is movekings.com (HTTP 200), but curl -L to it returns a site titled 'MoveKings' that is a DIFFERENT, unrelated moving company based in Longmont/Boulder/Denver, Colorado (its own nav lists Boulder/Longmont/Lafayette/Denver-area service pages, different phone/brand, no mention of 'Move Kingz' or North Miami anywhere in title/og:title/body). Per task instructions this generic-content/different-business match does NOT count as the business having its own site. Google Maps listing itself also confirms no website on file (gmaps_detail.js returned website:null, and the raw page snippet shows the 'Add website' prompt Google shows unclaimed-website profiles). WebSearch for Facebook/Instagram pages for 'Move Kingz LLC North Miami' and for 'Move Kingz' + the address/zip found no social media presence; the only indexed mention is a thin HireAHelper directory profile (hireahelper.com/movers/miami_fl/move-kingz-llc) with no reviews, no social links, and no independently verifiable pricing (its boilerplate text is templated across HireAHelper listings and conflicts with itself on years-in-business and service radius, so it was not used as a verified data source). Conclusion: has_own_site = false, confirmed via DNS + live content check + Maps + web search, no social channels found.

reviews_verbatim.author: Jasmine Campbell
reviews_verbatim.text: I highly recommend this moving company! This is my second time using their services, and once again they exceeded my expectations. The team was professional, efficient, and arrived on time. They handled everything with care and made the moving process smooth and stress-free. Their reliability and excellent customer service are why I chose them again, and I wouldn't hesitate to recommend them to anyone looking for dependable movers.

reviews_verbatim.author: Wannette Peterson
reviews_verbatim.text: This is is my 3rd time using this company in the past few years and always outstanding service! Owner is very knowledgeable about moving... spacial order for things to go into the truck and fit to make you money work for you. They always finished before the allotted time and even came back the next day to help repack some things I needed to ask. I've moved out of state now but I will ALWAYS refer them to anyone! Move with King Moverz and save yourself the hassle!

reviews_verbatim.author: L A
reviews_verbatim.text: Great company if you're looking for a fast and reasonably priced moving service! They were on time and on point throughout the entire move. Thank you!

reviews_verbatim.author: niki s
reviews_verbatim.text: Amazing movers! They were on time, friendly and got the entire move done within an hour. I only had a small bedroom size move, but I'm very impressed with how efficient they worked. Highly recommend them for your next move

reviews_verbatim.author: Miss B
reviews_verbatim.text: I give this moving company 10 stars!!! From start to finish, the movers did an amazing job!!! The owner EJ arrived 30 minutes early to prep for his crew. They were on time, efficient, and thorough. The amount of professionalism exhibited was extraordinary. Everything I asked was completed with no issues. I highly recommend them for any moving needs. I will definitely recommend them to everyone!

gallery_curation_notes: 11 Google Maps photos downloaded and viewed individually (one by one, full resolution) before selecting. Discarded: an exact duplicate of the chosen hero shot, and one cluttered closet shot dominated by visible Huggies diaper packaging (consumer-brand clutter, not representative). Used 9 of 11: hero/hero-reuse = crew member loading the truck (branded company shirt visible, outdoor daylight, sharp); wrapped-furniture-in-blankets (packing care); wrapped dresser near a doorway; masked crew member wrapping a glass-top dining table (action shot); stacked U-Haul boxes in a bedroom (packing volume); luxury high-rise condo living room mid-prep with Miami skyline view (shows higher-end clientele); disassembled bed frame (furniture assembly/disassembly service, matches 'furniture disassembly' review tag from Google's own review-summary tags); organized, fully-wrapped truck interior (packing quality); crew member working inside a residential hallway (on-site work, real estate art + ladder visible). No selfies or owner headshots used as gallery tiles. 'logo.jpg' is not a real logo (none exists, no website/social to source one from): it is a cropped, face-free detail photo of the moving truck's roof/clearance-light line against blue sky, used as a small square brand avatar the same way the Roland Custom Cabinets reference demo used a countertop detail photo in place of a logo. All used images verified as valid JPEG via `file`/PIL and resized to max 1000px wide.
notes: No pricing used anywhere on the site: a third-party HireAHelper directory listing showed an hourly rate, but its boilerplate language is templated/generic across many HireAHelper profiles and self-contradicts (years in business, service radius vs. stated out-of-state moves), so it was not treated as business-verified pricing. Site uses the 'Request a free quote' pattern throughout per PIPELINE.md adapted-variant guidance. Google Maps 'Identifies as Black-owned' attribute noted during research but not surfaced as marketing copy on the site (no independent means to verify beyond the Google-provided badge, and it is not needed to build an honest adapted-variant demo). Owner first name 'EJ' is referenced only because it appears verbatim, unprompted, in two separate real Google reviews (Miss B, and implicitly Wannette Peterson's 'owner' mention), used once in the About section copy. status: staging, not deployed by this routine (no wrangler deploy run, per task instructions).
